error.title: That didn't work
error.desc: We couldn't load this right now. Please try again in a moment.

overview.desc: Track and review your wellness journey through AI-driven insights.

timeline.desc: Track your activity history across all areas.
timeline.categoryEmpty: There is no activity in this category yet.

recall.desc: Ask Vitana about your memories and find patterns in your wellness journey.
recall.emptyDesc: Say for example “What improved my sleep?” — Vitana searches your memory and answers. Saved results appear here as soon as there are any.

permissions.desc: Decide who may see and use your health memories.
permissions.panelDesc: You manage visibility, data use and security in one place: your privacy settings.

privacy.desc: Your data, your decision — choose who sees what and what is shared.
privacy.passwordDesc: Change your password or get a reset link by email.
privacy.deleteDesc: Permanently delete your account and all your data.

preferences.desc: Adjust appearance and language the way that suits you.
preferences.accessibilityNote: Vitanaland follows your device's accessibility settings — for example “reduce motion” and your browser's text size.

business.opportunitiesEmpty: No leads yet. We'll let you know as soon as someone is looking for what you offer — keep your listings up to date.
business.listingsEmpty: No listings yet. Add one — or just tell Vitana “I'm offering …”.

discover.productDesc: Product details on the Vitana marketplace.
discover.providerSoonDesc: We only show real, verified providers here. As soon as there are some, you'll find their profile, availability and reviews in this place.
discover.marketplaceDesc: Buy and sell with the Vitana community.
discover.marketplaceMineEmpty: Post a buy or sell request — Vitana connects you with the right people.

inbox.archivedEmptyDesc: Archiving conversations isn't available yet. All your conversations stay in your inbox.
inbox.inspirationDesc: Templates you can copy and use in your conversations.

search.title: Search
search.emptyDesc: Try a different name — at least two letters.

members.emptyDance: Nobody has set this dance as a preference yet — be the first!

sharing.distributionDesc: Templates, automations and brand guidelines for your campaigns.
sharing.distributionEmptyDesc: Templates, rules and brand guidelines aren't available yet. You can already plan and send your campaigns under Campaigns.

post.desc: The post your notification is about.
post.notFoundDesc: It may have been deleted or is no longer visible. The News feed has everything new from the community.

privacy.desc: Choose who sees which parts of your profile. Tap a tier to change it.
